job_title: Software Engineer Java – Up to $150K + Full Benefits – Boston
job_description:
Position: Mid-Level Software Engineer

Location: Boston, Massachusetts

Compensation: Competitive Salary + Benefits Package

Work Setup: On-Site

Overview

We’re working alongside a leading organisation within the fintech space to identify a talented Software Engineer for their front-office aligned team in Boston. This opportunity is ideal for someone who has a proven track record of delivering reliable production systems and is keen to take on more ownership while contributing to business-critical, revenue-driving platforms in a fast-paced setting.

What they’re seeking
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field
• 2–5 years of professional development experience, with a focus on Java
• Experience working on complex, low-latency or performance-driven systems within financial services or related industries

Key responsibilities
• Build, optimise, and maintain scalable applications used by front-office users
• Work closely with trading desks, product stakeholders, and engineering peers to deliver high-quality solutions
• Support architectural decisions, enhance platform resilience, and promote best practices across the codebase

If this sounds aligned with your background, feel free to apply or reach out for a confidential discussion.
